message:
feat(keepalive-r2 ②): a standby entry can be let go -- Release

For the APK wiring (e): the phone keeps standby only while visible (onStop), a PC leaves the recent three, sign-out.
StandbyEntryClient::Release: parked -> ONE StandbyRelease (entry + secret), no retry (an unanswered one lapses on the
lease), then Idle -- no entry, no Ping; a new admission needs a new capability. Not while Active / Activating (a
granted entry refuses it; that session ends by itself). An older host stays Unsupported. StandbyLease::Release (not
while its socket is handed to a session).
Test: standby_entry_client_test 51/51 (+5); mutants relAlways (Release while active) / relKeep (stays parked) FAIL.
